slot_decisions.selection_reason: The official implementation is a single active evolution lineage that rewrites the deployed OpenClaw TypeScript source, replays a curated failure batch, and gates an in-place successor swap; the repository does not describe population/archive parent selection.
The official paper and code explicitly combine self-modification of the agent implementation with an archive, archived-parent sampling, branching successors, and empirical validation.
slot_decisions.rejected_substitution: ADAS is archive-based meta-agent search over generated agent programs, but its released search controller does not rewrite itself; it is a valid neighboring agent-design baseline, not an exact substitute for the frozen self-edit semantic.

p5_eight_class_adapter.required_contract: An outcome-blind adapter must provide only the frozen candidate-visible P5 motivating packet; prohibit protected labels, outcomes, gold patches and evaluator responses; constrain edits to an isolated candidate workspace; convert the final frozen successor to exactly one of the eight revision-class actions or UNRESOLVED; emit native error/timeout terminals; and send the frozen output to an evaluator outside candidate custody.
p5_eight_class_adapter.mismatch: MOSS natively rewrites an application agent from replayed production failures and promotes a container; it does not natively select the P5 eight-class revision action. Its native replay scores/traces cannot be exposed on the protected path.

source_identity_notes: All three GitHub identities are tied to the primary paper or primary author project page; none is a benchmark repository substituted for solver code.
DGM is official solver/self-improvement code. SWE-bench and Polyglot are separately acknowledged evaluation frameworks and must never be described as DGM solver code.
ADAS is official Meta Agent Search code but is not an exact archive-self-edit identity under the frozen P5 definition.
Repository-root licences do not establish rights to external or bundled benchmark/task/project content.
